title: Partner Success Manager
description:
At Jukebox Health , our mission is to empower everyone to live safer, healthier, more independent lives at home. We partner with health plans to make homes safer and more accessible for older adults and high-needs populations. We achieve this by combining technology with networks of clinicians, suppliers, and installers to deliver personalized home modifications and environmental supports nationwide. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, Jukebox Health is a fast growing healthcare services company backed by top venture capital firms like Valtruis and The Home Depot.

We are seeking a dynamic Partner Success Manager to join our Px team. This person will be instrumental in ensuring seamless partner onboarding, implementation, and ongoing success while serving as the critical bridge between our sales, operations, and clinical teams.
This role will be responsible for ownership of multiple partner accounts. As the account owner, this person represents the voice of the partner internally and the voice of Jukebox externally, keeping both sides aligned as the partnership moves forward. They own the key metrics that drive program optimization, own resolution of escalations, and proactively identify efficiencies and solutions before issues surface. We're ideally looking for this person to have clinical experience as an Occupational Therapist (OT) or Physical Therapist (PT) to give our partners a level of clinical insight and credibility that's hard to replicate. This is not a dedicated clinical specialist role, but a clinical lens shapes how this person engages with partners and approaches program design.
Key Responsibilities
Partnership & Account Management

• Maintain regular, proactive communication with partner stakeholders, ensuring satisfaction and engagement routinely

• Build trust and credibility with partner stakeholders across all levels and regions through consistent, informed engagement

• Translate partner feedback and requirements into actionable insights for product, operations, and clinical teams, and represent Jukebox's priorities and constraints back to partners

• Drive growth and expansion within existing partnerships by identifying opportunities for program enhancement and increased utilization

Program Optimization: Metrics & Performance

• Own partnership performance analytics and reporting, tracking key metrics and demonstrating value creation

• Identify trends and outliers in program data, diagnose root cause, and drive resolution through the right internal team

Proactive Solutions & Escalations

• Serve as the escalation point for partner relationship issues or systemic program concerns that day-to-day operational channels haven't resolved

• Identify bottlenecks in the partner journey and drive resolution cross-functionally

• Design and lead partner-facing engagement initiatives in response to what the data and field are surfacing, with clear outcome tracking

Implementation Execution

• Lead end-to-end implementation planning and execution for new partnerships, managing relationships from contract signature through program launch

• Develop and refine standardized implementation processes and documentation to ensure consistent, efficient partner onboarding

• Coordinate cross-functional teams including operations, clinical, and technical resources to deliver successful program launches on time and within scope

Qualifications
Required

• Clinical degree or licensure (OT or related healthcare credential)

• 3+ years of project management, consulting, partner/account management, or relevant experience in healthcare, preferably with managed care organizations, Medicaid, or other healthcare payers

• Demonstrated experience managing complex implementations or program launches

title: Senior Product Partnerships Manager
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Product Partnerships at Ramp is where we go when the right partner doesn't exist yet - or when the canonical partner doesn't move fast enough. The team owns the integrations that expand Ramp's product surface area: tax and compliance automation, agentic commerce, data partnerships, international payments, receipt and payment automation, and the technical substrate that lets Ramp plug into any system a customer runs.

This role isn't about hitting a quota. It's about picking the right partners in emerging categories, negotiating the terms, shipping the integration with our Product and Engineering teams, and turning the launch into something customers actually feel. Recent and active examples: selecting an AI-native VAT compliance partner, white-labeling eInvoicing for international markets, shipping receipt automation, building agentic payment partnerships, and negotiating data governance terms with the largest platforms in the industry.

You'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and GTM. You'll own deals end-to-end. The bar is partnerships that move Ramp's product forward - not deals that move a number on a dashboard.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the full lifecycle of strategic product partnerships: source, qualify, negotiate commercial and legal terms, structure the integration with Product and Engineering, launch, and scale

title: Research Hardware Engineer
description:
About Arbor Neuroscience 
(formerly Forest Neurotech)
Arbor is a nonprofit research organization working on one of the hardest open problems in clinical neuroscience: how to change brain circuits by design.
Millions of people with depression, chronic pain, and other brain disorders have no treatment that works. Modulating activity in the brain circuits underlying their symptoms - with electrical stimulation, focused ultrasound, or magnetic stimulation - can work spectacularly well. But it doesn't work reliably, and we can't predict who it will help.
That's what Arbor aims to fix. The starting point is a new class of experiment: intervene, measure how the circuit responds, track the symptom, and repeat in the same individual over months. We’re building the necessary experimental platform. It currently includes the Forest 1 ultrasound system, which works like a wearable functional MRI, but with higher resolution. The system images activity across large brain volumes, including deep brain structures, and will soon stimulate as well. We are also adding electrode-based interfaces in animal studies. From these data, we'll build models to make neuromodulation predictable.
Arbor is a Focused Research Organization within the Convergent Research family, and the new name for Forest Neurotech. We're a mission-focused nonprofit, doing multidisciplinary translational work that doesn't fit in a lab or on a company roadmap. We have the funding to run the first phase, and we're a small team - the people we hire now will shape what Arbor becomes.

Our benefits include:
Medical, dental, and vision - most plans fully covered for you and your dependents

description:

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About The Opportunity
Homeward is looking for an Analytics Engineer to help build, strengthen, and scale the data foundation that powers decision-making across the business.
This role is ideal for someone who is a confident, self-sufficient data professional with deep experience in data modeling and a passion for turning complex data into reliable, usable products. You’ll own critical pieces of our data pipeline and architecture while partnering closely with analysts, technical teams, and business stakeholders to ensure our data is accurate, dependable, and easy to consume.
A major focus of this role will be data reliability and scalability. We need someone who can identify why pipelines and models are breaking, build solutions that address the root cause, and create an architecture that can scale as our business and use of AI evolve. Most importantly, you take ownership. When you see an opportunity to make our data infrastructure more reliable, scalable, or useful, you're motivated to figure out how to make it better.
You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Homeward structures, governs, and delivers data-enabling analysts, business users, applications, and AI-powered tools to work from consistent and trusted information.
NOTE: Due to current team needs, we are only accepting candidates based in Latin America . This is intended to be a long-term contract position. It is not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship or relocation.
What You'll Do:

• Own the health and reliability of our data pipelines, proactively identifying issues and implementing durable solutions to prevent ingestion failures and downstream disruptions.

• Design, develop, test, and optimize scalable dimensional data models and data marts using dbt.

• Structure data models around abstract business definitions, creating a reliable connection between business logic and technical implementation.

• Help architect our data environment for AI-readiness, ensuring data is structured, documented, governed, and accessible in ways that support emerging AI use cases.

• Evaluate and implement tooling and validation processes to ensure dbt models and AI-enabled data workflows produce accurate and trustworthy outputs.

• Partner closely with Product and Technology teams on internal application and system changes, identifying upstream and downstream data dependencies and minimizing disruption.

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable solutions within our analytics platform.

• Develop deep domain expertise across key areas of Homeward 's business and serve as a technical point of contact for associated data models, metrics, and workflows.

• Establish monitoring, testing, documentation, and data-quality practices that improve confidence in our data.

• Identify opportunities to improve our overall data architecture and recommend practical solutions rather than waiting for requirements to be fully defined.

What You'll Bring:

• Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intel

title: Director, Groups & Events
description:

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020-2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role
We're looking for a Director of Groups & Events to lead our Groups Contracts and Groups Bookings teams. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in the details as much as in the strategy - someone who doesn't just oversee the work but genuinely understands it, can step into it, and uses that proximity to make the team and the customer experience meaningfully better every day.
You'll own the end-to-end support experience for group travel, from contract management through booking execution, and you'll bring the rare combination of operational depth, people leadership, and strategic clarity that this function requires. You know the workflows. You know where the friction lives. And you build the systems, the culture, and the team capability to eliminate it.
At Engine , we don't aim to meet industry benchmarks - we aim to make the industry benchmark against us. This role is for someone who holds themselves and their team to that standard.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop the Groups Contracts and Groups Bookings teams. You own performance, culture, and day-to-day operations across both teams. You develop your managers and leads with directness and intention - giving real feedback, building real capability, and creating the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers. The leaders who come up under you go on to run their own functions.
Be a player/coach and power user. You don't manage from a distance. You maintain deep, current working knowledge of end-to-end group handling - from initial inquiry and contract execution through booking confirmation and post-travel support. You can pull up a contract, work a complex case, navigate the systems your team uses every day, and identify exactly where the experience breaks down. Your proximity to the work is not occasional - it's how you lead. When a high-stakes situation arises, you're in it, not watching from the sidelines.
Drive continuous improvement relentlessly. You use data and direct observation to find problems before customers report them. You build feedback loops - from QA audits to coaching sessions to SOP rewrites to retraining cycles - and you close them. You don't flag issues and wait for someone else to fix them. You identify the root cause, build the solution, and measure whether it worked. Process improvement isn't a project for you - it's an operating mode.
Own the operational metrics. Establish baselines, track performance, and hold the team accountable to clear and measurable outcomes - booking conversion rate, L90 median timing, QA scores, SLA performance, and client satisfaction. You know which numbers matter, what's driving them, and what it takes to move them.
Manage BPO vendor performance. You have experience running BPO partnerships and you bring that discipline to the Groups function. You hold external partne

Peraton 's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.
Peraton is seeking a Business Analyst with deep expertise in NOAA Fisheries (the National Marine Fisheries Service, the federal agency within NOAA responsible for managing and conserving U.S. marine resources) data systems and consultation processes to serve as the dedicated NOAA Fisheries liaison on a federal data integration program. • Coordinate with NOAA Fisheries SMEs to obtain approval on schema harmonization decisions and ensure all data modifications are authorized

• Support development of NOAA Fisheries-specific decision logic and template content requirements

• Facilitate NOAA Fisheries partner office participation in pilot consultation workflows

• Serve as the primary liaison between the Peraton team and NOAA Fisheries

• Experience facilitating government stakeholder reviews and obtaining formal approvals

• Excellent written communication skills; experience producing government-facing documentation

• Experience coordinating multi-agency deliverable approvals (FWS + NOAA Fisheries)

•
Familiarity with federal data governance standards and OCIO-authorized data pathways

CBAP or equivalent BA certification

• Building and maintaining features across the stack - Python/FastAPI backend services, React/TypeScript frontends, and Postgres data models Triaging platform feedback from security engineers and repo owners: reproducing bugs, running data reconciliations in SQL, and closing the loop with users

• 1-3 years of software engineering experience (internships count), with solid Python fundamentals

• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases

• Comfort in a Linux/Git environment and a willingness to debug across unfamiliar systems

• Interest in security - you don't need to be a security expert yet, but you should want to become one

• Strong ownership instincts: you follow problems to root cause and communicate clearly along the way

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Frontend experience with React and TypeScript

• Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD/GitOps) or job-queue/worker architectures (Redis, Celery/ARQ)

• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, or similar)

• Security fundamentals: CTF participation, security coursework, bug bounty writeups, or certifications like Security+ or eJPT

• Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of shipped side projects

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
LEAD PRODUCT DESIGNER - CORTEX

📍 MANCHESTER (HYBRID, UP TO 4 DAYS WFH)

💰 COMPETITIVE SALARY, DEPENDENT ON EXPERIENCE

 

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

- At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

- Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

- We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON

- Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

- Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

- Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

- Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

- Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

- You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

- You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

- You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

- You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

- You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

YOU PROBABLY SHOULDN'T APPLY IF:

- Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

- You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

- You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

- You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A BIT ABOUT YOU

- AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

- Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (India)
description:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

- Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

- Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

- Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

- Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

- Experience: 3-10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

- Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

- Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in image review or measurement work.

- Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

- Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

- Language: Native or near-native written English.

LEGAL STATUS:

- You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

- You will work as an independent contractor.

WHY JOIN US?

- Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous.

- Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly.

- Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

Biotechnology is rewriting life as we know it, from the medicines we take, to the crops we grow, the materials we wear, and the household goods that we rely on every day. But moving at the new speed of science requires better technology. Benchling's mission is to unlock the power of biotechnology. The world's most innovative biotech companies use Benchling's R&D Cloud to power the development of breakthrough products and accelerate time to milestone and market. Come help us bring modern software to modern science.

We're hiring a leader to take that mandate and make it one of the strongest business technology functions in software.

The foundation is built. The integration practice is live and shipping. A recent identity re-architecture cut Salesforce access tickets by roughly 65% in three months. The business helps rank a prioritized roadmap, and that roadmap is full of work that moves revenue.

Three things are converging that make this the right moment to step in:

- Benchling is scaling. You'll own a portfolio spanning Salesforce/CPQ, NetSuite, Workday, Certinia, Gainsight, Zendesk, Atlassian, Slack, Workato, and the rest of the SaaS estate that Benchling runs on.

- The revenue and finance architecture is being rebuilt for the next stage of the company. Quote-to-cash, pricing and packaging, and consumption billing are all in motion, alongside the systems controls that public-company financial reporting requires. These are the programs that determine how fast Benchling can sell, bill, and close.

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

READY TO BUILD THE FUTURE OF MOBILE APP MONITORING?

This is no ordinary engineering role. At Sentry, our Mobile SDK team creates the next generation of tools for developers worldwide, processing over a billion events every single day. We're looking for a talented Senior iOS SDK Engineer to join our team of experts.

You'll dive deep into Apple's most advanced technology, from powerful new APIs and SwiftUI to Foundation Models. If you love using cutting-edge tech to solve complex challenges, you've found your team.

As the owner of our iOS SDK, you will guide its development from the core architecture to the final product experience. - Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to enhance productivity and code quality

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

- Well-organized with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- You live in the Vienna area or are willing to relocate for this incredible opportunity

BONUS POINTS

- Knowledge of the app monitoring and observability space

- Familiarity with low-level programming (C/C++)

- A track record of maintaining or contributing to open-source libraries

- Experience with other mobile platforms or frameworks (Android + Kotlin/Java, React Native + JavaScript/TypeScript, Flutter + Dart)

Your Mission

Develop and execute the partnership acquisition strategy for our healthcare network partners, identifying and prioritizing key players across industry associations and professional societies (e.g., hospital & health systems, physician & medical groups, home health, and skilled nursing/long-term care), franchise and multi-site provider networks, GPOs, and healthcare EHR / practice management / revenue cycle management integration ecosystems.

Source, negotiate, and close complex partnership agreements with enterprise-level organizations that drive significant new business and revenue for Engine by leveraging their portfolios, member bases, or client networks.

Cultivate and manage relationships with key executive stakeholders during partner acquisition and onboarding processes, including C-suite leaders and partners at target organizations, building long-term alignment and mutual success.

Successfully onboard new partners in collaboration with Partner Success, Partner Marketing, and Partner Program, driving post-signing momentum (partner referred deals).

Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations, to launch and support new partnerships.

title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
description: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 - Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.

De functie vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt, zorgvuldig rapporteert, risico’s tijdig signaleert en professioneel blijft handelen bij complexe zorgvragen.
Wie zoeken wij?
Wij zoeken geen starter, maar een zelfstandige basispsycholoog met minimaal twee jaar ervaring binnen de SGGZ. Je hebt een afgeronde master Psychologie, beschikt over een LOGO-verklaring en hebt aantoonbare scholing in Cognitieve Gedragstherapie, CGT.
Je bent gewend om professioneel en gestructureerd te werken, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een digitale werkomgeving. Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.
Ervaring of scholing in ACT, EMDR en schematherapie vinden wij waardevol. Dit is geen harde eis, maar wel een duidelijke pre. Datzelfde geldt voor ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en andere complexe zorgvragen binnen de SGGZ.
Verder is het belangrijk dat je uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Engels kunnen spreken is mooi meegenomen.
Waarom Beterggz?
Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en goede online zorg kunt leveren.
We werken op ZZP-basis met een uurtarief van €70 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we samen af en starten kan op korte termijn.
Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de kans om inhoudelijk sterk werk te doen én mee te bouwen aan een moderne manier van GGZ-zorg leveren.

title: Virtual Medical Receptionist
description:
Virtual Medical Receptionist
Remote | Neurology Facility | 40 Hours/Week | $5-$6/hour
Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and highly organized Virtual Medical Receptionist to support our busy US-based Neurology clinic. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong multitasking abilities, and experience working in a fast-paced healthcare environment.
The ideal candidate can effectively manage competing priorities, provide exceptional patient support, and maintain accuracy while handling a high volume of calls, referrals, and administrative tasks.
Key Responsibilities
Appointment Scheduling

• Coordinate and schedule patient appointments accurately and efficiently.

• Manage appointment confirmations, reschedules, and cancellations.

• Maintain provider schedules and optimize appointment availability.

Prior Authorization (Medication)

• Process medication prior authorization requests.

• Communicate with insurance companies, pharmacies, providers, and patients regarding authorization status.

• Follow up on outstanding requests to ensure timely patient care.

Insurance Verification

• Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits prior to appointments.

• Document insurance information accurately within the EMR system.

• Identify and communicate any coverage limitations or issues.

Referral Handling

• Receive, process, and track incoming and outgoing patient referrals.

• Coordinate with referring providers, specialists, and insurance companies as needed.

• Ensure referral documentation is complete, accurate, and properly attached to patient records.

• Follow up on pending referrals to help facilitate continuity of care.

Patient Communication

• Answer inbound calls professionally and courteously.

• Respond to patient inquiries, appointment requests, and administrative concerns.

• Maintain excellent customer service while supporting a high call volume clinic environment.

Required Skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

• Ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining professionalism and accountability.

• Comfortable handling high call volumes and multiple administrative responsibilities simultaneously.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant supporting a US-based clinic.

• Experience with appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and patient communication.

• Familiarity with healthcare workflows, medical terminology, and EMR systems.

• Experience managing referrals and coordinating patient care is preferred.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

• Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) .

• Previous experience supporting a Neurology practice .

• Experience working in a busy clinic environment with high patient and call volumes .

This position is ideal for a Virtual Medical Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced healthcare setting, can confidently manage a high volume of patient interactions, and is committed to providing outstanding support to both patients and providers.
